generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: poppies with 2 (or 3) sepals and twice as many petals; the bleeding-hearts (Fumariaceae) with sepals 2, small and scale-like, and petals 4 in 2 dissimilar pairs; ovary superior. Merosity 2: two sepals, and petals in two pairs.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 267 Papaveraceae (poppies) and 268 Fumariaceae (bleeding hearts and fumitories), which APG joins as Papaveraceae: annual to perennial herbs, rarely shrubs or small trees; leaves alternate (rarely the floral ones opposite), often much divided; stipules none; fruit a capsule opening by valves or pores, in the fumitories a capsule or a nut.
